text: Swimming is an enjoyable and effective way to stay fit. When beginning, the focus should be on kicking smoothly and efficiently. Kicking is the foundation of a strong swim stroke, ensuring that the body moves through the water with power and grace. As confidence grows, swimmers then focus on breathing, which should occur every three to five strokes, allowing for a balanced and continuous stroke. This strategic breathing pattern helps maintain endurance and ensures that the swimmer remains calm and focused throughout the duration of a swim session.
